disclaimer: Demonstration fixture only. This ACR exercises the machine-checkable ACR lifecycle end-to-end (PROPOSED → ENDORSED → APPROVED → IMPLEMENTED) with synthetic actors, timestamps and references. It makes no claim about real architecture changes and cannot route real protected-path changes or sanction real reconciliations.
title: Demo: sample architecture-control change approval lifecycle
problem: Demo fixture: a sample architecture-control change needs the full machine-checkable approval chain — Architect review and Product Owner approval with explicit roles, verdicts and ordering — before it may be cited by work-item records or route protected-path changes.
evidence: Demo fixture evidence: the lifecycle rules in governance/README.md (Architecture changes).
Demo fixture evidence: acr.schema.json defines the machine-checkable gates.
impact: Demo fixture: demonstrates that an ACR cannot be cited by an acr_resolved work-item transition before its Product Owner approval, and that implementation tracking is bidirectional with the implementing work item's acr field.
alternatives: Demo alternative one: skip the lifecycle and let any PR touch protected paths — rejected (silent architecture changes).
Demo alternative two: single-role approval — rejected (both gates are required).
recommendation: Demo fixture: exercise the full PROPOSED → ENDORSED → APPROVED → IMPLEMENTED chain with the sample architecture-control change implemented by SAMPLE-002.
migration_plan: Demo fixture: SAMPLE-002 resumes implementation through the acr_resolved transition citing this ACR, then proceeds through the normal lifecycle to a historical merged-record reconciliation.
compatibility: Demo fixture: no real record, registry or path is affected; the demo id range ACR-9xx keeps this record excluded from real routing and real reconciliation sanctioning.
security_impact: Demo fixture: the record proves the validator rejects demo ACRs from real routing, real citations and real reconciliations (demo marking is enforced on both sides of every reference).

review.rationale: Demo fixture: the sample change preserves frozen boundaries and the ACR lifecycle rules are satisfied.

approval.rationale: Demo fixture: the Product Owner authorizes the sample architecture-control change after the Architect endorsement.

provenance: Demo fixture created by ARCH-WF-002 (Issue #12) as the reproducible architecture-change approval example required by the work item's acceptance criteria.
